# export.arxiv.org / arxiv.org fixtures

A two-entry Atom feed in the API's real shape (2026-09-14): a versioned new-style id and an old `cs/9901002` id, a title split across lines, a DOI and journal reference. `id_list=burst` answers the 14-byte `Rate exceeded.` 429 the API sends with no Retry-After. PDF and e-print bodies are minimal.
